title: Understanding the Location Format
text: The location is formatted as "StreetNumber StreetName, 5DigitZIPCode". Focus on extracting the StreetName part.

title: Identifying the StreetName
text: StreetName consists of only letters and spaces. It follows the StreetNumber and precedes the comma and ZIP code.

title: Using Regular Expressions
text: Use a regular expression to capture the StreetName. Remember, StreetNumber is numeric and StreetName is alphabetic.

title: Constructing the Regular Expression
text: To extract the StreetName, use the pattern: \d+\s([A-Za-z\s]+). This captures the StreetName after the StreetNumber and space.
